blocks.text: Rare and more aggressive than DLBCL. First-line therapy is usually

S: cyclophosphamide (IV) day1 750 mg/m2 1-hour infusion AND doxorubicin (IV) 50 mg/m2 15 minutes’ infusion day 1 AND vincristine (IV) 1.4 mg/m2 over 10 minutes (maximum 2mg) day1 AND prednisolone (PO) 100mg once a day, day 1–5 AND etoposide 100mg/m2 (IV) day 1-day 3; repeat every 21 days for 6–8 cycles.

blocks.text: For MALT lymphoma, eradication of Helicobacter pylori is essential. Splenectomy is recommended in splenic marginal zone lymphoma.
Topical corticosteroids are indicated for localized or generalized skin involvement in mycosis fungoides. Systemic therapy is indicated for non-responders and Sezary syndrome.

S: fludarabine AND Cyclophosphamide (FC) regimen is used as a second-line therapy for indolent B-cell lymphoma.
